description: Time Series Merge ALBs: replica-group merging, TSM fanout failures, global evaluation outcomes and latency, and the raw series cache beneath global evaluation.

panels.title: Group failures
panels.description: Share of logical replica groups that gave no usable answer in merged TSM requests over the time range, all TSM ALBs combined. Each failed group makes its response partial, with a warning naming the group. Without replica_group set every member is its own group, so this is the share of member answers lost.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_attempted"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Group fallbacks
panels.description: Share of replica groups over the time range answered by a replica other than the group's first configured member, because that member was down or gave nothing usable. Results stay complete, but the group has lost redundancy. Stays 0 unless replica_group puts several members in one group.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="fallback"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_attempted"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Shard failures
panels.description: Failed member responses inside TSM fanouts over the time range: truncated or short bodies, panics, clone failures, capture-budget fail-fasts and variant merge failures. no_contribution is left out because it re-counts these; lost replica groups show in Replica group failures.

targets.expr: sum(increase(trickster_alb_fanout_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm", reason!="no_contribution"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Eval failures
panels.description: Share of global evaluations over the time range that failed on the server side: execution (limits included), timeout, unavailable or internal. Client-caused bad_data and canceled outcomes and partial answers are not failures here. Queries answered from the results cache are not evaluated and not counted.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"execution|timeout|unavailable|internal"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Partial answers
panels.description: Share of answered global evaluations over the time range that left out at least one member, because it was unreadable or its reads failed while partial_response is true (the default). Such answers carry a warning and are never cached.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status="partial"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"success|partial"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Mean eval time
panels.description: Mean wall time of a global evaluation over the time range: slot wait, raw reads, PromQL engine and response encoding, failed evaluations included. It times the work behind a results-cache miss, not client latency, so cache hits are excluded.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__range])) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Raw hit ratio
panels.description: Share of cacheable member selector reads over the time range that the raw series cache served fully or in part (hit or phit). Reads that bypass the cache (proxy-only: entirely recent or older than raw_cache_window) are excluded. Low after a restart or for constantly new queries; dashboards with moving ranges should run mostly from cache.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"hit|phit"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status!="proxy-only"}[$__range])) > 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Read failures
panels.description: Failed member raw series reads during global evaluation over the time range, counted once per member per selector. Includes transport and status errors, fetch limits, and client cancellations and deadlines, so closing a dashboard mid-query adds to it. Members already down before an evaluation are not counted here; they show as partial or unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(increase(trickster_alb_global_member_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Replica events/s
panels.description: Replica-group events per second in merged TSM requests (all TSM ALBs), by event and plan variant (standard, or the avg-/variance- parts of a split query). group_attempted: one per group per request; group_failed: no replica answered usefully; fallback: answered by a later replica; suppressed: redundant replica answers set aside; conflict (dashed, right axis): data points where replicas disagreed.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (event, variant) (rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), "variant", "standard", "variant", "")

panels.title: Group failure and fallback ratios
panels.description: Of all replica groups merged, the share that gave no usable answer (the response is partial) and the share answered by a replica other than the first configured one (complete, but with less redundancy). Fallbacks need replica_group with several members per group; group failures happen with or without it.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_attempted"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="fallback"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_attempted"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Replica groups per merged request
panels.description: Logical replica groups merged per TSM scatter call, by plan variant. It should equal the number of distinct shards configured in the pool: with replica_group set on HA replicas, each pair counts once; without it, every configured member is its own group, down members included, so sums and counts include each replica separately. Merges of scalar results record no groups and pull this down.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (variant) (rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="group_attempted"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (variant) (rate(trickster_alb_fanout_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "variant", "standard", "variant", "")

panels.title: Conflicting points per redundant replica
panels.description: Average number of data points where a redundant replica's answer differed from the authoritative (first configured) replica's, per redundant answer compared; the first replica's value is kept. 0 means replicas agree. Replicas that scrape independently, such as an HA Prometheus pair, disagree slightly on computed values, so watch for changes rather than the level. Needs replica_group.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="conflict"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_tsm_replica_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="suppressed"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: TSM fanouts/s by variant
panels.description: TSM scatter calls per second, all TSM ALBs combined. standard is one call per merged request; a query split into partial aggregates (avg into avg-sum and avg-count, stddev or stdvar into the variance- parts) calls once per variant. Requests that are not mergeable, single-member bypasses and global-evaluation queries do not fan out.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (variant) (rate(trickster_alb_fanout_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm"}[$__rate_interval])), "variant", "standard", "variant", "")

panels.title: TSM shard failures/s by reason
panels.description: Failed member responses per second in TSM fanouts. truncated: body over max_capture_bytes; short_read: body ended early; routing_flap: either after the member fell below Passing; aggregate_cap: fail-fasted by max_fanout_capture_bytes; merge: a variant failed to merge and the request got a 502; no_contribution: a member or group gave nothing usable, including non-2xx answers, and re-counts the other reasons.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(trickster_alb_fanout_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failing shards per TSM fanout
panels.description: Average failed member responses per TSM scatter call: transport and capture failures (panic, aggregate_cap, clone, short_read, truncated), and members or groups without a usable contribution (which overlaps the first and adds non-2xx answers). Not a percentage: one call to N members can lose several.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(trickster_alb_fanout_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm", reason=~"panic|aggregate_cap|clone|short_read|truncated"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_fanout_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum(rate(trickster_alb_fanout_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm", reason="no_contribution"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_fanout_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", mechanism="tsm"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Global evaluations/s by status
panels.description: PromQL evaluations per second over members' raw series for ALBs with tsm.evaluation: global, by outcome. partial: a member was left out; execution: a limit (max_samples, max_fetched_series, max_fetched_samples, max_capture_bytes) or engine error; timeout: query_timeout, including the wait for a max_concurrent_queries slot; unavailable: no readable member, or one failed with partial_response false; canceled: client left; bad_data: invalid query. Results-cache hits are not evaluations, and one client query can need several.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failure and partial ratios
panels.description: Per global ALB: the share of evaluations that failed on the server side (execution, timeout, unavailable, internal; solid) and the share of answered evaluations that left out a member (dashed). Client-caused bad_data and canceled outcomes are in neither.

targets.expr: (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"execution|timeout|unavailable|internal"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status="partial"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"success|partial"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"success|partial"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Evaluation time: mean and quantiles
panels.description: Wall time of global evaluations across the selected ALBs. The histogram's buckets are 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10 and 20 s, so quantiles are interpolated (values under 50 ms only mean fast), and anything over 20 s (the default query_timeout is 2 m) reads as 20 s: compare with the timeout rate above. The mean comes from the exact sum and is not capped.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Evaluation time distribution
panels.description: Share of global evaluations finishing within 1 s and within 5 s, and taking longer than 20 s, the histogram's top bucket (timeouts at the default 2 m query_timeout land there). Exact at these bucket bounds, unlike the interpolated quantiles.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", le=~"1|1.0"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", le=~"5|5.0"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

1 - (sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", le=~"20|20.0"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))

panels.title: Raw series and samples per evaluation
panels.description: Raw series (solid, left axis) and samples (dashed, right axis) read per evaluation, from members and the raw series cache together, before replica deduplication; what max_fetched_series and max_fetched_samples limit. Failed evaluations that got as far as reading count too; evaluations that failed earlier add nothing but still count in the denominator.

targets.expr: sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_fetched_series_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_fetched_samples_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_evaluation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Member read failures/s
panels.description: Failed raw series reads per second by global ALB and member (top 10), counted per member per selector, so one evaluation can add several. Includes client cancellations and deadlines and, with partial_response false, incomplete answers. A member that was already unhealthy is skipped, not counted.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (alb_name, member) (rate(trickster_alb_global_member_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Client queries by results-cache status
panels.description: Instant and range queries reaching global ALBs, by whether the ALB's results cache answered them (hit) or an evaluation ran (kmiss and other misses). A result is reused only for the same query and times, so moving dashboard ranges miss while repeats and concurrent viewers hit; partial and failed results are never cached.

targets.expr: sum by (cache_status) (rate(trickster_proxy_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", backend_name=~"$alb", path=~"query|query_range"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (backend_name) label_replace(group(trickster_alb_global_evaluations_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}) by (alb_name), "backend_name", "$1", "alb_name", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Raw reads/s by cache status
panels.description: Member selector reads per second through the raw series cache. hit: every sample older than the volatile window came from cache (only the volatile window, 5 m for mimir and thanos members, is read); phit: older gaps were read from the member; kmiss: nothing was cached; proxy-only: the span is entirely volatile or older than raw_cache_window, so the member is read directly.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Raw cache hit ratios
panels.description: Per global ALB, of reads the cache could serve (proxy-only excluded): the share served entirely from cache (full hit, solid) and served at least in part (any hit, dashed). A gap between the two means ranges keep reaching past what is cached, as when a dashboard widens its range.

targets.expr: (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status!="proxy-only"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status!="proxy-only"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"hit|phit"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status!="proxy-only"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status!="proxy-only"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Cache-served reads using a broader selector
panels.description: Share of cache-served reads (hit or phit) filled at least in part from the cached blocks of a broader selector on the same metric and member, such as up{job="api",code=~"5.."} from up{job="api"}. Only selectors with an exact metric name qualify. Each instance remembers which selectors it has cached in memory, so after a restart this stays near 0 until broader ones are cached again.

targets.expr: sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_subsumed_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (alb_name) (rate(trickster_alb_global_raw_reads_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", alb_name=~"$alb", status=~"hit|phit"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Raw cache store refusals and failures/s
panels.description: Raw series cache operations that failed, per cache (all global ALBs using it), by reason. tsm_global_raw_max_object_size is a refusal, not a fault: a two-hour block reached the ALB's max_object_size_bytes (64 MB by default for TSM), so those samples are read from members every time. Other reasons are store, retrieve or decode failures whose samples are re-read next time.

targets.expr: sum by (cache_name, reason) (rate(trickster_cache_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", event="error", reason=~"tsm_global_raw_.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: The Prometheus-compatible data source that scrapes Trickster's /metrics endpoint.

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Scrape job(s) holding the Trickster targets.

list.name: alb
list.label: ALB
list.description: TSM ALBs with tsm.evaluation: global, listed from a series each one exports from startup. Filters the Global evaluation and Raw series cache rows; merge and fanout panels have no ALB label and ignore this choice.

title: Trickster / Time Series Merge (TSM)
